reserveReview.rationale: At Robinhood Chain block 124275851 (2026-11-27T13:16:48Z, hash 0xbacbb39bba8763c547877f6e4abdbd08cfefa2f46c6c2de3731503e95fbdac0c), EUSD totalSupply() was 141,513.729828 eUSD, reconciling exactly to totalDebt() across all active minters: EUSDPsm (65,879.28 eUSD), EUSDLiquidityManager USDG (75,101.23 eUSD across two USDG/eUSD vaults and one frxUSD/eUSD vault), legacy eSPY EUSDManager (383.60 eUSD, mint paused), and EUSDManager B (149.62 eUSD), with zero debt in Managers A, C, D, and EUSDLiquidityManager Low Vol. Measuring external collateral only and excluding self-referential minted eUSD held inside FablesAdapter LP ranges (69,831.61 eUSD in USDG/eUSD vaults and 5,711.01 eUSD in the frxUSD/eUSD vault, which auto-burns on unwind), net external collateral totaled $147,472.63 (104.2% of gross supply, 223.5% of net non-vault float): 131,811.86 USDG ($131,798.68 at $0.9999 Chainlink oracle, 89.37%: 65,879.28 in EUSDPsm plus 65,932.58 in Fables USDG/eUSD vaults), 9,288.59 frxUSD ($9,287.66 at $0.9999 oracle, 6.30%), 8.436286 eSPY ($6,158.36 at $729.9847 legacy Chainlink oracle, 4.18%), and 0.1323 WETH ($227.93 at $1,722.8095 Chainlink oracle, 0.15%). Because EUSDLiquidityManager vaults hold concentrated-liquidity positions whose external-token vs self-minted eUSD mix shifts with Fables pool ticks, Pharos uses curated-validated with live Robinhood Chain totalSupply() checks.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pinned Robinhood Chain on-chain reads of EUSDPsm ERC-20 reserves, FablesAdapter vault holdings() excluding self-minted eUSD, and EUSDManager totalCollateral() valued via Own's on-chain ChainlinkOracleVerifier at block 124275851 (2026-11-27T13:16:48Z)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All active collateral buckets and debt totals are read directly from Robinhood Chain contracts, with self-minted eUSD inside Fables LP ranges excluded from external reserves. Concentrated-liquidity LP vault composition shifts dynamically as pool prices move, and security reviews published in own-protocol/own-v2/audits were multi-agent adversarial reviews rather than audits by a named independent human security firm.
